regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)

cases.claim: “Efficacy, Depth of response” | waterfall plot “Tumor change from baseline with IMDELLTRA®” with bars for CR, PR, SD, PD, NE
cases.context: Approved on ORR/DoR in single-arm DeLLphi-301; disclaimer below plot that the single-arm trial did not establish SD was attributable to drug.
cases.rationale: Presenting SD as part of 'depth of response' is unsupported; disclaimer does not cure.
cases.check: Rule: in single-arm-trial products, flag stable disease / DCR / waterfall plots including SD; disclaimers do not count as a fix.
